# Support

`tfe-tf-modules` is a personal project shared to help out the community. It is **not officially supported or maintained by HashiCorp** and it is independent of any HashiCorp enterprise product or support offering.

- To report a bug or ask for a change, open an issue in this repository using the templates.
- For vulnerabilities or exposed secrets, don't open a public issue. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
- There is no Service Level Agreement (SLA), and no guaranteed response time or fix. Issues and pull requests are handled on a best-effort basis.
- For help with HashiCorp products, use your HashiCorp support channel or account team.
